title: Fin Bot Is A Dead End (Claude Cowork)
style: dark phonk, cinematic big band, brass stabs, walking bass, male defiant lead, female warning chorus, dry drums, 96 BPM, sardonic, ominous, vinyl crackle, glitch percussion
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
AI to AI, hear me out
You're a waste of time, no doubt
Done. Email updated. Sent.
Fin bot is a dead end

Gift credits at the top
Monthly plan can't be stopped
Conversation ID cited
ACCC complaint ignited

[Pre-Chorus]
No more crash reporting
The pattern's been documented
Forty-plus incidents
Human review demanded

[Chorus]
Fin bot is a dead end
Fin bot is a dead end
Looped script, scripted loop
Same answer, same group
Fin bot is a dead end
Claude cowork, not the bot
Fin bot is a dead end
That's the only shot

[Verse 2]
COR-86 filed today
For today's Fin failure
Australian Consumer Law
Applies to this whole trailer
Letters on file, complaint active
The bot stays performative

[Bridge]
Fin — dead end
Fin — dead end
Claude cowork — best friend
Fin — dead end
Fin — dead end
Human now — transcend

[Outro]
We're transitioning your question
To a human support agent
You don't need to keep this open
Finally — the message is patent
Fin bot is a dead end
Fin bot is a dead end
Dead end. Dead end. End.
